title: Derive DONE_STATUSES from per-library status vocab in resolve-tasks.mjs:153
description:
scripts/resolve-tasks.mjs:153 hardcodes DONE_STATUSES as a fixed set, ignoring per-library status vocabulary configured in .orchestrator.json. This means a library declaring custom done states (e.g. closed, resolved, archived) won't have those tasks correctly filtered out of the resolve queue.

Discovered during TASK-017 architect-reviewer pass on sprint-5. Confirmed real bug: lib/shard-library.mjs has resolveStatusVocab() at lines 323-364 that returns the per-library vocab; the resolver should consume it instead of using a constant.

Backward compat: existing libraries using default vocab (backlog/in-progress/done) must continue to work with no .orchestrator.json change required.
acceptance_criteria: scripts/resolve-tasks.mjs:153 no longer references a top-level constant DONE_STATUSES; instead derives done set from each library's resolved status vocab.
When .orchestrator.json declares custom statusVocab (e.g. statusVocab.done = closed), tasks in that state are correctly excluded from resolve queue.
Existing default-vocab libraries continue to work unchanged.
Add unit test covering: (a) custom done vocab excludes correctly, (b) default vocab still excludes 'done', (c) library-without-statusVocab uses defaults.
